data.name: BaseExpressionLabel
data.comment: Label of the base expression field

data.name: TokenOnlyIfTaken
data.value: Add a number only if the value is already taken

data.name: TokenSequenceHint
data.value: The next number from a counter kept for the target attribute. Optionally fixed width.

data.name: StyleLabel
data.comment: Label of the suffix style select

data.name: StartAt
data.comment: Label of a counter's first value

data.name: NeverReuseLabel
data.comment: Switch label, and the locked row for a sequence

data.name: PadNotAvailableNumber
data.value: Not available: a Number attribute cannot hold leading zeros. Choose a Text attribute for fixed-width values.
data.comment: Shown for a Number target, where padding cannot apply

data.name: PadOffOrOn
data.value: Off: plain numbers. On: zero-padded to the width below.

data.name: WidthExceededTitle
data.value: When the number outgrows the width

data.name: StopAndReportHint
data.value: For fixed-length validation downstream. The object fails with a clear reason; nothing is written.

data.name: AllowLongerHint
data.value: The width becomes a minimum: a number that would no longer fit grows past it instead of failing.

data.name: SequenceAlwaysOn
data.value: Always on for sequence numbers: the counter only moves forward.

data.name: FormatLabel
data.comment: Label of the random token format

data.name: MissingInputTitle
data.value: If an input has no value

data.name: WaitForInputs
data.value: Wait until every input has a value

data.name: WaitForInputsHint
data.value: Recommended for generated values: a value built from a missing input would be kept for ever.

data.name: EvaluateAnywayHint
data.value: Only if the expression handles missing values itself, for example with IIF and IsNullOrEmpty.

data.name: AttemptLimitHelper
data.value: Candidates tried per object per run before the object fails.

data.name: CannotBeSaved
data.comment: Heading above the list of validation errors

data.name: ImportStatement
data.value: 1. No higher-priority source supplies {0} for the Metaverse Object. JIM generates a value the first time and keeps it from then on. Like any Attribute Flow taking the attribute over, it replaces a value a higher-priority source left behind when it stopped supplying one.

data.name: ImportTargetFallback
data.comment: Used for {0} when no target name is known

data.name: ExportStatement
data.value: 1. JIM generates {0} the first time it exports it to a Connected System Object and keeps that value from then on. A value the Connected System already holds is replaced; to set it only on accounts JIM creates, turn on Initial Export Only.
data.comment: {0} is the target attribute name, or the fallback value

data.name: ExportTargetFallback
data.comment: Used for {0} when no target name is known

data.name: NoInputsToWait
data.value: 2. No inputs to wait for: the base expression is empty.

data.name: EveryInputHasValue
data.value: 2. Every attribute the base expression reads has a value:

data.name: ThenOnceKept
data.value: 3. Then once only. The value is kept even if these inputs later change.

data.name: ThisValueFallback
data.comment: Used as the attribute name when no target name is known

data.name: GeneratedOnceKept
data.comment: Summary of when the value is generated

data.name: GeneratedOnceWhenInputs
data.value: Generated once, when every input has a value, then kept even if they change.

data.name: NeverReuseOff
data.value: Off: once JIM stops holding a value, it can be issued again, possibly to a different person.

data.name: NeverReuseOn
data.value: On: once JIM stops holding a value, it is never issued again. Turn this off only if a value may safely pass to a different person.

data.name: OnlyIfTakenNumberHint
data.value: Needs a base expression; not available for a Number attribute.

data.name: OnlyIfTakenAddBaseHint
data.value: Needs a base expression; add one above, or choose a Sequence or Random token instead.

data.name: RandomSubtextNumber
data.value: Digits only for a Number attribute; GUID and hex are text.

data.name: RandomSubtext
data.value: A GUID, or a short hex or digit string. A clash draws again.

data.name: BaseExpressionNumberHint
data.value: Not available for a Number attribute: a prefix or letters would make the value text.

data.name: BaseExpressionHint
data.value: Reads the source object's attributes. Optional for a Sequence or Random token.
